title: 🔆🔅November 4th - An important message from the Supreme Leader of Iran, Ayatollah Seyyed Mojtaba Khamenei marking the National Day of Combating Global Arrogance, read by TV presenter.
text:
🔆🔅November 4th - An important message from the Supreme Leader of Iran, Ayatollah Seyyed Mojtaba Khamenei marking the National Day of Combating Global Arrogance, read by TV presenter."

""
"========"

" "Now, the story of America's longstanding enmity toward the Muslim nation of Iran, and the courageous resistance of all Iranians against this enemy, has reached a point where not only November 4, but every day and every hour, has become a time of steadfastness and struggle against the Great Satan.""

""Now, the situation in the Persian Gulf, particularly in the Strait of Hormuz, has exposed the falsehood of the myth of America's invincibility. It demonstrates the weakness and humiliation of governments that rely on powers other than their own people, as well as the disloyalty and inability of major powers to defend their puppet regimes. Iran's management of the Strait of Hormuz and the destruction of US military bases in countries across the region, although a response to US aggression and crimes during the Third Imposed War, also constituted an initial offensive jihad against global arrogance on a regional scale. Should these acts of aggression be repeated, it will take on much broader dimensions.""

" "This display of strength, alongside the unity of the various arenas of the Front of Truth and the intelligent and powerful acts of heroism by the Resistance Front, from Palestine and Lebanon to Iraq and Yemen, is a bright and hopeful harbinger of the rising flag of the Front of Truth and the groundwork being laid for a new global order. For whenever the Front of Truth is armed with reliance on God, steadfastness, and self-sacrifice, the Front of Falsehood, whatever its power or capabilities, and whoever or whatever it may be, will be unable to withstand it. Retreat and defeat will be its inevitable fate.""

""Today, as a result of the arrogant powers' self-inflicted disgrace, America's declining power and hegemony have suffered an irreversible collapse in both dimensions of hard military power and international soft power, and the process of its disintegration has accelerated.""

" "If there are still those who hold even the slightest hope for a change in behavior or partisan and factional shifts within the system of hegemony, or who imagine that by granting concessions to America they can dissuade it from its hostility toward the Iranian nation, they are gravely mistaken. This mistaken belief is an expression of ingratitude toward the great victories that the Muslim nation of Iran has achieved through reliance on God, steadfastness, and struggle.""

""The wish of the Great Satan is the unconditional surrender of the Iranian nation. Even the slightest inclination toward surrender to the hegemonic enemy would squander the immense capital gained through the blood of the martyrs and the sacrifices of the people, and would embolden the arrogant enemy to pursue further demands, wage further wars, and commit further acts of aggression.
